reason: Provides a minimal-prompt coding agent preset centered on multi-step orchestration, with file tools, shell execution, planning, subagents, and workflow capabilities, including Git Bash and persistent PowerShell support on Windows.

summaries.zh: 为编码智能体提供极简提示词的 PTC 模式，支持多步编排、文件操作、Shell 执行、规划、子代理和工作流，并包含 Windows Git Bash 与持久 PowerShell 支持。
summaries.en: Provides a minimal-prompt PTC coding-agent mode with multi-step orchestration, file operations, shell execution, planning, subagents, workflows, and Windows Git Bash and persistent PowerShell support.

capabilities: Provides an alternative minimal-prompt agent mode
Orchestrates multi-step TypeScript Code Mode operations
Executes shell commands through Git Bash
Maintains persistent PowerShell sessions on Windows
Supports planning, goals, skills, subagents, and workflows
